[h2][b]Update [/b][/h2][p][b]Main changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Big graphical update[/p][/*][*][p]Added languages: Turkish, French, Portuguese and Italian[/p][/*][*][p]Story mode added (about 45 hours long)[/p][/*][*][p]Added 91 achievements[/p][/*][*][p]God powers in spectator mode[/p][/*][*][p]The bot factions have some diplomacy options[/p][/*][*][p]Music[/p][/*][/list][h2]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/689344bd7b92c3b898d2843465a0a3056628e805.png"][/img][/h2][h2]Blog[/h2][p]From the start, I’ve been ramping up towards October’s Next Fest. I was confident and ahead of schedule, but then I changed the graphics at the last minute and now I’ll have to rework the store page in full panic… it always ends in panic.[/p][p]You might know that Steam hides all new games until they reach a certain number of wishlists and/or sales. This is so the 50,000 trash games released each year won’t flood the market.
[b]DSS 2[/b] has reached 8,000 wishlists and even entered “Popular Upcoming” on Steam. I’m expecting to release in November with around 14,000 wishlists. I finally registered my company two weeks ago - something I’d been putting off because of the hard-hitting taxes in Sweden.[/p][p]I’ve projected that I’ll be able to pay myself about €1,500 a month from the game. That’s low compared to my old job (€4,000/month), but I’m pretty good at living on almost nothing. I just have to pray to Freya to keep my computer alive.
So now I’m officially a game developer - hurray :)[/p][p]Now when I can use the government child day care. I have started to practice streaming some playtesting. I’m not great at talking in front of a camera, but hopefully will get better.  
[/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@vikingfabian/streams"]https://www.youtube.com/@vikingfabian/streams[/url][/p][p]

notes.title: Shadows and Foam
notes.content:
[p]Finally, a much-needed graphical update![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/e5e32303c4431ef50e3c330f5bb54bc5b5dfaa2e.gif"][/img]
People are enjoying the demo, just talked to a guy who has played it 15 times. But I have been struggeling with appeal. During August I emailed 250 Vtubers, and not a single one of them tried the game. This has been horrifying a wake-up call. 
Luckily, the MonoGame team (the framework I use) recently released a shadow effect example, which I used to finally add shadows.
[url="https://monogame.net/blog/2025-07-16-3d-starter-kit/"]https://monogame.net/blog/2025-07-16-3d-starter-kit/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/679677d58064a461d789da2e4ce4004c1d7b50b9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/f8697ed124b923171c680db77797fa41506d89e2.png"][/img][/p][p]I also added water effects. They use a masking model around edges and ships, combined with a displacement shader.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/5f83f430c35f7601d9521b1af72f10554a0955e5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/7f1f9bc37545776b94015c5aca46db71331df61d.png"][/img][/p][p]I’ve also been tinkering with new map algorithms for my Map 2.0 plans. There’s still a lot left to do, though; it might be ready by winter 2026. 

An early experiment building up the map from chains of mountains:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/f1cf965c9d71b1c77d19fb571cb78f6811b3b868.png"][/img][/p][p]This is a heightmap of a mountain:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/13185c9aab22ec9fe364a4ed55291d2bcbe56274.png"][/img][/p][p]Let’s end on a positive note: I’m way ahead of schedule and all features are complete. I have even moved the release date to sooner - right alongside “Europa Universalis V”, But you will need something to play while they patch the launch bugs, right? ;)[/p]

notes.title: Needed a horse — got a Workshop project
notes.content:
[p]Sometimes game development can escalate, and you just have to roll with the punches.
 I noticed that there are many strategic ways to counter cavalry, but there's only one riding unit—and it's really hard to get. I need more…[/p][p]Recruiting already has a flavor of “combine anything,” so I thought: why not let players combine any animal and weapon to make units? But I can’t create thousands of models, so instead I’ll make a modular soldier system that combines legs, arms, heads, and so on.
 That opens up creative possibilities: why not let the player design their units in a character creator menu?[/p][p]While working on the modular parts, I realized I needed better editor tools. So I remade the voxel editor to better fit my needs, and I thought: why not make it available for everyone? That led me to see this as the perfect starting point for Steam Workshop—design fun characters, share them, and play with them in-game.[/p][p]The modular soldiers have now taken over the whole project, and the playtesters seem to enjoy the creativity. It will be the last feature I add before the game launches in November. Online multiplayer has been postponed to next year.[/p][p][/p][p][i]The updated voxel editor[/i] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/745aec518042edb61c74588f9bb58c44931512f0.png"][/img]
[i]Old vs. new soldier model comparison — new is on the right[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/0bb278e5ba9868c344bb82290ae28fbda0e77c09.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Multiplayer, Controller Support, and a Canceled Story
notes.content:
[b]Main Update Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Local split-screen multiplayer
[*]In-game controller support (Steam Input must be turned off)
[*]Extended demo to 90 minutes
[*]Lots of small improvements
[/list]

[b]Development Blog[/b]
Last week I attended two gaming expos: the Nordic Game Festival and Creative Coast. I went there hoping to network and get media coverage. It was a lot of fun, but honestly, a total waste of time.

I received many complaints about the demo length — it’s nice that you like it so much! But still, it’s a bit odd that people don’t realize demos have limits. I extended the demo a bit, but Steam best practices recommend a one-hour limit, and I don’t want to “shit where I eat,” as they say. DSS1 is still free and has no limits.

The story is canceled. I asked around, and there was very little interest in it, so I’ll focus that energy on other features.
